Soft pieces

Vegetable nuggets

Zöldséges nuggets

8 months+ Adjusted 35 min 4 portions

Offer soft nuggets that squash between your fingers. Do not serve any whole beans.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 100 g broccoli (cooked until soft)
  • 1 medium carrot (cooked until soft)
  • 120 g white beans (cooked weight, fully boiled, or unsalted canned and rinsed)
  • 1 egg (cooked through)
  • 30 g oats
  • 1 tsp olive oil (for the paper)

Allergens

egggluten

Method

  1. Cook the broccoli and carrot until very soft, and use white beans that have been boiled until completely soft.
  2. Mash the vegetables and beans so no whole beans remain.
  3. Stir in the egg and oats, and add no salt.
  4. Shape small nuggets and bake at 190 C on oiled paper until just set, with a soft outside rather than a hard crust.
  5. Cool and check that a nugget squashes easily.

Adjusted

These nuggets are often salted and cooked until the oat coating turns hard. White beans are not safe for a baby unless they are fully boiled.

Mash broccoli, carrot, and fully boiled white beans with egg and oats, and bake them only until just set. Keep the outside soft and add no salt.
